source_gate: Concentration-based apparent equilibria in mixed solvent cannot label a pure-waterI0target without a justified solvent/activity/temperature bridge.
secondary_protocol_gate: The paper has separate experimental setups for aminoindane/alanine cases; those conditions must not be inherited from the general protocol.
novelty: Potential structurally unfamiliartransamination chemistry; not a measured pure-waterbenchmark.

close_methodological_precedent.method: B3LYP/6-311+(d,p) molecular optimizations and additive reaction electronic energy differences, used to screen transamination thermodynamics; thermal/solvent/dynamical terms omitted under a cancellation assumption.
close_methodological_precedent.implication: Atomistic reaction-energy decomposition and reuse of molecular energies predate MetaG. Novelty must concern the demonstrated MLIP biochemical framework and validated benefits, not the atomistic route itself.
